signal: Formal project controls: milestones, schedules, dependency tracking, risk registers, status reporting, governance cadence, and acceptance criteria.
market_basis: Recurring requirement pattern in current public program/project-management descriptions reviewed 2026-10-02.
rule: Create an interrogation target; do not convert market demand into a candidate-experience claim.

signal: Budget ownership, resource planning, financial tracking, procurement, and cost accountability.
market_basis: Recurring across public program/operations descriptions; current resume directly supports P&L and some cost modeling but omits scale for most projects.
rule: Ask for scale, decision rights, and documented outcomes.

signal: Vendor, contractor, supplier, service-agreement, implementation-partner, or procurement management.
market_basis: Common in cross-functional implementation and quality/operations roles.
rule: Missing from resume is not evidence of absence.

signal: Quantified outcomes: defects, cycle time, audit findings, budget variance, adoption, quality, throughput, incident reduction, delivery performance.
market_basis: Current descriptions consistently emphasize measurable delivery/outcomes.
rule: Prefer measured facts; do not manufacture percentages.

signal: Deviation/nonconformance investigation, CAPA or corrective-action ownership, root-cause analysis, and closure effectiveness.
rule: Use CAPA terminology only if the underlying process actually used CAPA; otherwise preserve 'corrective action/root-cause analysis'.

signal: SOP ownership, controlled documents, training records, change control, inspection-ready evidence.
market_basis: Recurring requirement in quality-system job descriptions.
rule: Do not infer GxP/GMP/GCP or document-control ownership from ISO/CAP/CLIA experience.

signal: Audit/inspection readiness, finding management, evidence packages, regulatory response, and closure tracking.
rule: Map to ISO/CAP/CLIA and healthcare audit evidence; do not relabel it as FDA/GCP/GMP without support.

signal: Hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, training programs, workload planning, and team development.
rule: Team size is supported; hiring/performance-management details require human confirmation.

signal: Implementation scale: users, sites, systems, data volume, geographic reach, rollout phases, go-live/cutover scope.
rule: Ask for exact scale and ownership boundary.

signal: Named systems/platforms, integrations, architecture, SDLC/release practices, technical interfaces, and tooling.
market_basis: Common in technical program and regulated-operations descriptions.
rule: Existing resume names several AI/automation tools but omits many healthcare/lab platforms.

signal: Cross-functional stakeholder scale, executive governance, steering committees, external partners, regulators, vendors, and collaborators.
rule: Resume supports cross-functional work, but scale and decision rights remain under-specified.

signal: Incident management, escalation, rollback, postmortem, monitoring, and corrective follow-through.
rule: Do not translate general problem-solving into formal incident-management practice without evidence.
